程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.foundation

类 UIStyle

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.foundation.UIStyle
public final class UIStyle extends Object
Centralized modern FLAT UI styling for the JobHere platform. Pure flat design — no gradients, consistent white inputs, rounded corners. Full Chinese (中文) compatibility via platform-appropriate fonts.
